note: Offshore western-Superior buoys do NOT show the coastal-upwelling wind→cooling response (surface WTMP corr with favorable wind speed ~0 / slightly negative) — coastal upwelling is a NEARSHORE phenomenon these deep-water buoys miss. The favorability curve therefore stays the physics prior (Wedderburn ~12-17 kt; Li et al. 2021 r=-0.87). A nearshore logger or a GLSEA north-shore-pixel analysis is the calibration path; documented gap (docs/SUBSURFACE_SOURCES.md).
